source: Manual archaeology pass over Realmz source map field-value render, movement, LOS, and secret handlers

realmzSourceAnchors.finding: MyrBitSetShort/MyrBitClrShort/MyrBitTstShort use bit position 15 - b; source comments identify bit 1 as note marker and bit 2 as path marker.
fastplotmap renders negative values by drawing the current landlook base tile and ploticon3(id), while positive values over 999 clear note/path bits and subtract 1000 bands before terrain render.
Outdoor render branches negative field values to cicn icon rendering before note/path checks; positive values can draw secret, note, and path overlays after normalization.

Movement checks Data Solids only for raw -1..-998 values, clears note/path bits on positive values, treats values beyond +/-2999 as undetected secret areas, and treats positive values above 999 as door/action state.
LOS checks clear note/path marker bits and subtract positive 1000 bands before consulting mapstats[hit].los.

fieldValueLayers.runtimeMeaning: Landlook terrain tile with mapstats movement, LOS, sound, and combat attributes after normalization.
fieldValueLayers.providenceTreatment: Primary Landlook Tiles palette and source-backed tile attribute inspector.

fieldValueLayers.runtimeMeaning: Current landlook base terrain plus cicn icon art; raw -1..-998 can be solid through Data Solids.
fieldValueLayers.providenceTreatment: Special Land / Icons palette, icon-resource preview, Data Solids solidity evidence.

fieldValueLayers.runtimeMeaning: Door/action/secret/path/note field state normalized by clearing note/path bits and subtracting 1000 bands.
fieldValueLayers.providenceTreatment: Raw / Advanced unless created through known AP, secret, note, or path workflows.

fieldValueLayers.rawShape: positive field value with Realmz bit 1 set
fieldValueLayers.runtimeMeaning: Rendering clears this bit before tile lookup and draws note overlay art.
fieldValueLayers.providenceTreatment: Contextual note/map-record evidence badge; writer support needs Divinity/source proof.

fieldValueLayers.rawShape: positive field value with Realmz bit 2 set
fieldValueLayers.runtimeMeaning: Runtime marks path-capable traversed tiles by setting this bit; render clears it and draws path overlay art.
fieldValueLayers.providenceTreatment: Runtime mutation evidence by default; avoid presenting as ordinary terrain.

fieldValueLayers.rawShape: values beyond +/-2999 and related reduced bands
fieldValueLayers.runtimeMeaning: Hidden/undetected/detected secret-area handling in movement and render paths.
fieldValueLayers.providenceTreatment: Preserve and explain until Divinity editor labels/defaults are proven.

editorImplications: Classify negative high-magnitude values as special/icon candidates, not generic marker-bit tiles.
Classify positive high values as Realmz field state and keep arbitrary authoring in Raw / Advanced.
Show note/path bits only for positive values because negative render paths branch to icon drawing before note/path handling.
Represent path bits as likely runtime mutation evidence unless authored through a future explicit path workflow.
Add selected-cell evidence for raw value, normalized terrain, icon candidates, note/path bits, positive state band, and secret/door suspicion.

confidenceDebt.finding: centerpict and fastplotmap normalize very negative values differently; screenshots or runtime fixtures are needed before one universal icon candidate rule is claimed.
Realmz source proves runtime behavior, but Divinity binary/manual work is still needed for editor labels, defaults, and safe authoring controls.
Runtime note overlay behavior is source-backed, but the exact authored relationship between note-marked cells, Data MD2 map notes, and Divinity UI remains to be proven.
